notes.title: Format of the Activity Sheet
notes.content:
**Total Marks:** 80 | **Total Time:** 180 min

1. **(A) Language Study** (08 Marks, 10 min) 
   **(B) Language Study** (02 Marks, 05 min)
2. **(A) Comprehension of Textual Passage** (10 Marks, 15 min) 
   **(B) Comprehension of Textual Passage** (10 Marks, 15 min)
3. **(A) Comprehension of Poem/Extract** (05 Marks, 10 min) 
   **(B) Appreciation of Poem** (05 Marks, 10 min)
4. **(A) Non-textual Passage for Comprehension** (10 Marks, 20 min) 
   **(B) Summary of Passage for Comprehension** (05 Marks, 10 min)
5. **Letter Writing (Formal OR Informal)** (05 Marks, 15 min)
6. **(A) Information Transfer: Verbal to Non-verbal OR Non-verbal to Verbal** (05 Marks, 15 min) 
   **(B) Views/Counterview OR Drafting a Speech** (05 Marks, 15 min)
7. **(A) Expand the theme: Expansion of Proverbs/Maxims/Quotations/Slogans OR News Report based on the given headline** (05 Marks, 15 min) 
   **(B) Developing a Story OR Narrating an experience with a given beginning/ending** (05 Marks, 15 min)
   **Review of solved Activity Sheet** (10 min)

notes.title: General Instructions & Study Tips
notes.content:
*   **General:** Read each poem/lesson as many times as you can. Study all activities in the textbook. The wording may differ, but the content will be based on the textbook.
*   **Comprehension:** Be familiar with every lesson (Prose and Poetry). Solve ALL side panel activities and 'English Workshop' questions.
*   **Vocabulary:** Solve all vocabulary exercises. Learn meanings of words and phrases from every lesson. Practise forming nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs. Learn antonyms, prefixes, and suffixes.
*   **Grammar:** Brush up on grammar. Learn Transformation of Sentences (use 'no sooner... than', add question tag, frame wh- questions, remove 'too', use 'unless', remove 'not'). Learn different tenses, prepositions, adverbs, articles. Grammar and Vocabulary carry 22 marks total—aim for full marks.
*   **Poetry:** Mark out figures of speech and rhyme schemes while revising. Repeatedly read the appreciation of all poems beforehand.
*   **Summary:** Understand what to include and exclude. Read the instructions in Question Set 5.
*   **Writing Skills:** Read as many topics as you can in addition to the textbook. Keep your general knowledge and knowledge of current topics good.
